+// Package acceptance holds the spec's acceptance tests A1-A9: plain Go tests
+// over httptest and server.New, run by go test ./... like every other test.
+// Each one drives the whole app over HTTP, so it needs no store of its own:
+// server.New opens a temporary database when Config.DataDir stays empty.
+package acceptance
+
+import (
+	"encoding/json"
+	"io"
+	"net/http"
+	"net/http/cookiejar"
+	"net/http/httptest"
+	"strings"
+	"testing"
+
+	"git.aisoftwarefactory.world/linkshort2/linkshort2/internal/server"
+)
+
+// newClient returns a browser of the API: an http.Client that keeps the
+// session cookie a login sets and never follows a redirect, so a test reads
+// the 302 of a short link as the answer it is.
+func newClient(t *testing.T) *http.Client {
+	t.Helper()
+	jar, err := cookiejar.New(nil)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	c := &http.Client{Jar: jar}
+	c.CheckRedirect = func(*http.Request, []*http.Request) error {
+		return http.ErrUseLastResponse
+	}
+	return c
+}
+
+// newServer starts the app on a listener of its own, in a temporary data
+// directory, and returns it with a client that talks to nothing else.
+func newServer(t *testing.T) (*httptest.Server, *http.Client) {
+	t.Helper()
+	srv := httptest.NewServer(server.New(server.Config{DataDir: t.TempDir()}))
+	t.Cleanup(srv.Close)
+	return srv, newClient(t)
+}
+
+// send asks url with method and body and answers the status, the headers and
+// the whole body, having closed the response.
+func send(t *testing.T, c *http.Client, method, url, body string) (int, http.Header, []byte) {
+	t.Helper()
+	var r io.Reader
+	if body != "" {
+		r = strings.NewReader(body)
+	}
+	req, err := http.NewRequest(method, url, r)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if body != "" {
+		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
+	}
+	res, err := c.Do(req)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	defer func() { _ = res.Body.Close() }()
+	b, err := io.ReadAll(res.Body)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	return res.StatusCode, res.Header, b
+}
+
+// get asks url with GET and answers status, headers and body.
+func get(t *testing.T, c *http.Client, url string) (int, http.Header, []byte) {
+	t.Helper()
+	return send(t, c, http.MethodGet, url, "")
+}
+
+// post asks url with POST and answers status, headers and body.
+func post(t *testing.T, c *http.Client, url, body string) (int, http.Header, []byte) {
+	t.Helper()
+	return send(t, c, http.MethodPost, url, body)
+}
+
+// wantStatus posts or gets url and fails unless the status is want, returning
+// the body read.
+func wantStatus(t *testing.T, c *http.Client, method, url, body string, want int) []byte {
+	t.Helper()
+	code, _, b := send(t, c, method, url, body)
+	if code != want {
+		t.Fatalf("%s %s: status %d, want %d (%s)", method, url, code, want, b)
+	}
+	return b
+}
+
+type meBody struct {
+	ID    int64  `json:"id"`
+	Email string `json:"email"`
+}
+
+type linkBody struct {
+	Slug      string `json:"slug"`
+	TargetURL string `json:"target_url"`
+	Clicks    int64  `json:"clicks"`
+}
+
+const longPassword = "correcthorsebatterystaple"
+
+// signup registers email, logs the account in and answers what GET /api/me
+// then names, so the returned client holds the session cookie.
+func signup(t *testing.T, c *http.Client, baseURL, email string) meBody {
+	t.Helper()
+	wantStatus(t, c, http.MethodPost, baseURL+"/api/signup",
+		`{"email":"`+email+`","password":"`+longPassword+`"}`, http.StatusCreated)
+	wantStatus(t, c, http.MethodPost, baseURL+"/api/login",
+		`{"email":"`+email+`","password":"`+longPassword+`"}`, http.StatusOK)
+
+	var me meBody
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(wantStatus(t, c, http.MethodGet, baseURL+"/api/me", "", http.StatusOK), &me); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	return me
+}
+
+// createLink shortens target, with the custom slug when one is given, for the
+// logged-in client and answers the created link.
+func createLink(t *testing.T, c *http.Client, baseURL, slug, target string) linkBody {
+	t.Helper()
+	body := `{"url":"` + target + `"}`
+	if slug != "" {
+		body = `{"url":"` + target + `","slug":"` + slug + `"}`
+	}
+	var l linkBody
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(wantStatus(t, c, http.MethodPost, baseURL+"/api/links", body, http.StatusCreated), &l); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	return l
+}

+package acceptance
+
+import (
+	"encoding/json"
+	"net/http"
+	"testing"
+)
+
+// TestA2CreateRedirectList is A2: create a link; GET /<slug> answers 302 with
+// the target in Location; the list shows 1 click.
+func TestA2CreateRedirectList(t *testing.T) {
+	srv, c := newServer(t)
+	signup(t, c, srv.URL, "ada@example.com")
+
+	const target = "https://example.com/the/long/page"
+	link := createLink(t, c, srv.URL, "a2target", target)
+
+	code, headers, _ := get(t, c, srv.URL+"/"+link.Slug)
+	if code != http.StatusFound {
+		t.Fatalf("GET /%s: status %d, want 302", link.Slug, code)
+	}
+	if got := headers.Get("Location"); got != target {
+		t.Errorf("Location %q, want %q", got, target)
+	}
+
+	var links []linkBody
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(wantStatus(t, c, http.MethodGet, srv.URL+"/api/links", "", http.StatusOK), &links); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if len(links) != 1 {
+		t.Fatalf("the list holds %d links, want 1", len(links))
+	}
+	if links[0].Slug != link.Slug || links[0].Clicks != 1 {
+		t.Errorf("list entry %+v, want slug %q with 1 click", links[0], link.Slug)
+	}
+}

+package acceptance
+
+import (
+	"net/http"
+	"testing"
+)
+
+// TestA3DuplicateSlugBadScheme is A3: a custom slug taken twice answers 409,
+// and a URL of the ftp scheme answers 400.
+func TestA3DuplicateSlugBadScheme(t *testing.T) {
+	srv, c := newServer(t)
+	signup(t, c, srv.URL, "ada@example.com")
+
+	createLink(t, c, srv.URL, "a3taken", "https://example.com/first")
+
+	code, _, body := post(t, c, srv.URL+"/api/links",
+		`{"url":"https://example.com/second","slug":"a3taken"}`)
+	if code != http.StatusConflict {
+		t.Errorf("a second link with the taken slug: status %d, want 409 (%s)", code, body)
+	}
+
+	code, _, body = post(t, c, srv.URL+"/api/links",
+		`{"url":"ftp://example.com/file","slug":"a3scheme"}`)
+	if code != http.StatusBadRequest {
+		t.Errorf("an ftp target: status %d, want 400 (%s)", code, body)
+	}
+}
